title: Towards High-Value Datasets determination for data-driven development: a systematic literature review
reasoning: The paper focuses on the economic, social, and environmental value of Open Government Data (OGD) and High-Value Datasets (HVDs) for societal development and public sector innovation. While it touches upon societal impact and sustainable development goals, it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as its core subject.
